info.longName: Hoya Capital High Dividend Yield ETF

funds_data.description: The index is a rules-based index that is designed to provide diversified exposure to 100 U.S.-listed real estate-related securities that collectively provide income through high dividend yields. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund’s net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, will be invested in dividend-paying securities, which includes equity securities that have paid a dividend in the prior 12 calendar months.
